Project Overview
01
The idea of the platform is to provide a one-stop solution for end-users to handle their presence online
02
There are several modules designed to achieve the same, such as follows,
Existence Management
Help users reach-out to their existence online
Identify harmful information/setting kept turned on
Help users update the settings based on their wish
Let the user remove the places where they do not belong
Provide users an ease to opt-out from the places their existence is harmful and/or unwanted to them
03
Another major module is to let users create groups with their friends and families, so that they all can see their posts from various social media platforms and stay updated to be with them in their hard times.

03

04

05
Handling digital presence on a timely basis and extracting new data was itself a big challenge at that time.
